SELECT T1.ORDER_ID bizCode, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T4.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T1.IS_NEED_SEND, T1.PAY_TYPE payType, TO_CHAR(T1.SETTLE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') SETTLE_DATE, T1.SETTLE_AMT, T1.CCY, T3.ACCT_NO payAcctNo, T3.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, T2.ACCT_NO recAcctNo, T2.ACCT_NAME recAcctName, T2.LARGE_PAYNO largePayNo, T1.SEND_STATUS sendStatus, T1.ORDER_STATUS orderStatus, T1.PURPOSE, T1.REMARK FROM STL_DVP_ORDERS T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 /*收款方*/ON ((T1.PS = #{PS01} and T1.MY_ACCT_NO = T2.ACCT_NO) OR (T1.PS = #{PS02} and T1.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T2.ACCT_NO)) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 /*付款方*/ON ((T1.PS = #{PS02} and T1.MY_ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO) OR (T1.PS = #{PS01} and T1.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO)) LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN #{item}
AND instr(T1.ORDER_ID, #{bizCode}) > 0
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{payDateStart}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{payDateEnd}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND T1.SEND_STATUS = #{sendStatus}
AND T3.ACCT_NO like concat(concat('%',#{counterAcctNo}),'%')
and T1.Order_Status!='02'

SELECT T1.TRADE_ID bizCode, nvl(T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE,T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE) PA_BUSS_TYPE, t2.PORTFOLIO_ID, t4.PORTFOLIO_NAME,
T3.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo, T3.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO recAcctNo, T2.ACCT_NAME recAcctName, T2.LARGE_PAYNO largePayNo,
t5.FINPROD_ID, t5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, NVL(T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T5.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, T1.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, TO_CHAR(t1.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') TRADE_DATE, TO_CHAR(t1.SETTLE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') SETTLE_DATE, T1.TRADE_AMT, t1.CCY, T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO, T6.MY_ACCT_NO, SSAI.REGIST_ORG, case when t9.ORDER_ID is null then '${DISPOSE_STATUS_02}' else '${DISPOSE_STATUS_01}' end dealStatus FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T6 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T6.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO T7 ON T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T7.ACCT_NO AND T1.CCY = T7.CCY AND T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T7.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH T9 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T9.TRADE_ID and exists(select 1 from STL_DVP_ORDERS where T9.order_id=STL_DVP_ORDERS.order_id and (STL_DVP_ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS is null or STL_DVP_ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS!='02')) left join BID_RESULT_TOTAL BRT on T1.B_TRADE_ID = BRT.TOTAL_WIN_ID left join BID_ORDER bo on bo.BID_ID = BRT.BID_ID
LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SSAI ON SSAI.SEC_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID AND SSAI.TRD_ACCT_CCY = T1.CCY
LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 /*收款方*/ON ((T6.PS = #{PS01} and T6.MY_ACCT_NO = T2.ACCT_NO) OR (T6.PS = #{PS02} and T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO =T2.ACCT_NO)) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 /*付款方*/ON ((T6.PS = #{PS02} and T6.MY_ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO) OR (T6.PS = #{PS01} and T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO =T3.ACCT_NO))
WHERE T1.IS_CANCEL = #{NO} and t1.TRADE_STATUS=#{TS_01} AND (T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ( #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_09}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_10}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_74}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_75}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_20}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_19}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_11}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_51}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_52}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_76}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_77}) OR ( T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ( #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_180}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_202}) and T1.TRADE_MARKET in (#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02})) OR ( T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ( #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_151}) and T1.TRADE_MARKET in (#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02}) and bo.PAY_TYPE = #{PAY_TYPE_01}) OR (T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN (#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_11}) AND T1.PS = #{T03}) OR (T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{F29}, #{F30})) OR (T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{F02}, #{F03})) ) /*查询债券、回购交易场所为银行间，证券账户来源是理财、是否发送指令是否*/ AND SSAI.SEC_ACCT_SOURCE = #{ACCOUNT_SOURCE_01} AND SSAI.TRADE_PLACE = #{TRADE_PLACE_01} AND T6.IS_NEED_SEND = #{NO} AND SSAI.REGIST_ORG IN ('01', '02') AND T1.IS_OUT_TRADE != 'N'
AND T2.PORTFOLIO_ID IN #{item}
AND instr(T5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, #{finprodMarketId}) > 0
AND instr(T1.TRADE_ID, #{bizCode}) > 0
AND SSAI.REGIST_ORG = #{acctType}
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{settleDateStart}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{settleDateEnd}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND nvl(T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE,T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE) IN #{item}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH tt where tt.TRADE_ID = t1.TRADE_ID)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH tt where tt.TRADE_ID = t1.TRADE_ID)
AND (T2.ACCT_NO like concat(concat('%',#{counterAcctNo1}),'%') OR T3.ACCT_NO like concat(concat('%',#{counterAcctNo1}),'%') )
UNION ALL
SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID bizCode, nvl(T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE,T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE) PA_BUSS_TYPE, t1.PORTFOLIO_ID, t4.PORTFOLIO_NAME,
T3.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo, T3.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO recAcctNo, T2.ACCT_NAME recAcctName, T2.LARGE_PAYNO largePayNo,
t5.FINPROD_ID, t5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, NVL(T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T5.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, T1.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, TO_CHAR(t1.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') TRADE_DATE, TO_CHAR(t1.SETTLE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') SETTLE_DATE, T1.TRADE_AMT, t1.CCY, T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO, T6.MY_ACCT_NO, SSAI.REGIST_ORG, case when t9.ORDER_ID is null then '${DISPOSE_STATUS_02}' else '${DISPOSE_STATUS_01}' end dealStatus FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T6 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T6.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO T7 ON T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T7.ACCT_NO AND T1.CCY = T7.CCY AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T7.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH T9 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T9.TRADE_ID and exists(select 1 from STL_DVP_ORDERS where T9.order_id=STL_DVP_ORDERS.order_id and (STL_DVP_ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS is null or STL_DVP_ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS!='02'))
LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SSAI ON SSAI.SEC_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID AND SSAI.TRD_ACCT_CCY = T1.CCY
LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 /*收款方*/ON ((T6.PS = #{PS01} and T6.MY_ACCT_NO = T2.ACCT_NO) OR (T6.PS = #{PS02} and T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO =T2.ACCT_NO)) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 /*付款方*/ON ((T6.PS = #{PS02} and T6.MY_ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO) OR (T6.PS = #{PS01} and T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO =T3.ACCT_NO))
WHERE T1.IS_CANCEL = #{NO} and t1.TRADE_STATUS=#{TS_01} AND SSAI.SEC_ACCT_SOURCE = #{ACCOUNT_SOURCE_01} AND SSAI.TRADE_PLACE = #{TRADE_PLACE_01} AND T1.IS_OUT_TRADE != 'N' /*BS-252 去除下面条件限制 债券交易STL_PAY_ORDERS.TRADE_ID存的是TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID modifly by caojin 2020/6/23 start*/ AND (T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ( '76', '77', '52', '51','11','19','20','74','75') OR (T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F29', 'F30')) ) /*BS-252 去除下面条件限制 债券交易STL_PAY_ORDERS.TRADE_ID存的是TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID modifly by caojin 2020/6/23 end*/
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN #{item}
AND instr(T5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, #{finprodMarketId}) > 0
AND instr(T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, #{bizCode}) > 0
AND SSAI.REGIST_ORG = #{acctType}
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{settleDateStart}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{settleDateEnd}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND nvl(T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE,T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE) IN #{item}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH tt where tt.TRADE_ID = t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH tt where tt.TRADE_ID = t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID)
AND (T2.ACCT_NO like concat(concat('%',#{counterAcctNo1}),'%') OR T3.ACCT_NO like concat(concat('%',#{counterAcctNo1}),'%') )
UNION ALL SELECT T1.TRADE_ID bizCode, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_81} PA_BUSS_TYPE, T2.PORTFOLIO_ID, t4.PORTFOLIO_NAME, case T2.PS when '02' then T2.MY_ACCT_NO else T2.COUNTER_ACCT_NO end as payAcctNo, case T2.PS when '02' then SCI.ACCT_NAME else SCI1.ACCT_NAME end payAcctName, case T2.PS when '02' then T2.COUNTER_ACCT_NO else T2.MY_ACCT_NO end as recAcctNo, case T2.PS when '02' then SCI1.ACCT_NAME else SCI.ACCT_NAME end recAcctName, '', '', '', '', '', TO_CHAR(t1.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') TRADE_DATE, TO_CHAR(t1.SETTLE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') SETTLE_DATE, T1.TRADE_AMT, t1.CCY, T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO, T6.MY_ACCT_NO, '' REGIST_ORG, case when SDTM.ORDER_ID is null then '02' else '01' end dealStatus FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH SDTM ON T1.TRADE_ID = SDTM.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN STL_DVP_ORDERS T2 ON T2.ORDER_ID = SDTM.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T6 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T6.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI ON T2.MY_ACCT_NO = SCI.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI1 ON T2.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = SCI1.ACCT_NO and exists (select 1 from STL_DVP_ORDERS where SDTM.order_id = STL_DVP_ORDERS.order_id and (STL_DVP_ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS is null or STL_DVP_ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS != '02')) WHERE T1.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and t1.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN (#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_88}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_89},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_90},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_91},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_92},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_93})
AND T2.PORTFOLIO_ID IN #{item}
AND instr(T5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, #{finprodMarketId}) > 0
AND instr(T1.TRADE_ID, #{bizCode}) > 0
AND 1 = 2
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{settleDateStart}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{settleDateEnd}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and 1=2
AND nvl(T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE,T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE) IN (#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_88}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_89},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_90},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_91},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_92},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_93})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH tt where tt.TRADE_ID = t1.TRADE_ID)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH tt where tt.TRADE_ID = t1.TRADE_ID)
AND (T2.MY_ACCT_NO like concat(concat('%',#{counterAcctNo1}),'%') OR T2.COUNTER_ACCT_NO like concat(concat('%',#{counterAcctNo1}),'%') )

SELECT T1.TRADE_ID bizCode, T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE, t2.PORTFOLIO_ID, t4.PORTFOLIO_NAME, t5.FINPROD_ID, t5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, NVL(T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T5.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, TO_CHAR(t1.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') TRADE_DATE, TO_CHAR(t1.SETTLE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') SETTLE_DATE, T1.TRADE_AMT, t1.CCY, T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO, T6.MY_ACCT_NO, T6.SETTLE_AMT, T6.PS , T7.ACCT_TYPE, T6.PAY_TYPE FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T6 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T6.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO T7 ON T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T7.ACCT_NO AND T1.CCY = T7.CCY AND T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T7.PORTFOLIO_ID
WHERE T1.TRADE_ID IN #{item}
WHERE T1.TRADE_ID IN (select TRADE_ID FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId})
UNION ALL
SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID bizCode, T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, t4.PORTFOLIO_NAME, t5.FINPROD_ID, t5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, NVL(T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T5.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, TO_CHAR(t1.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') TRADE_DATE, TO_CHAR(t1.SETTLE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') SETTLE_DATE, T1.TRADE_AMT, t1.CCY, T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO, T6.MY_ACCT_NO, T6.SETTLE_AMT, T6.PS , T7.ACCT_TYPE, T6.PAY_TYPE FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T6 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T6.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO T7 ON T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T7.ACCT_NO AND T1.CCY = T7.CCY AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T7.PORTFOLIO_ID
WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IN #{item}
WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IN (select TRADE_ID FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId})

SELECT T1.ORDER_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T4.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T1.IS_NEED_SEND, T1.SETTLE_DATE, T1.SETTLE_AMT, T1.CCY, T1.PAY_TYPE, T3.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo, T3.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, T3.BANK_DEP, T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO recAcctNo, T2.ACCT_NAME recAcctName, T2.LARGE_PAYNO largePayNo, T2.BANK_DEP recBankDep, T2.IN_OUT_BANK, T1.PURPOSE, T1.REMARK, T6.HI_USER operatorUser, TO_CHAR(T6.CREATE_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') operatorTime, T7.HI_USER checkUser, TO_CHAR(T7.CREATE_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') checkTime FROM STL_DVP_ORDERS T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 /*收款方*/ON ((T1.PS = #{PS01} and T1.MY_ACCT_NO = T2.ACCT_NO) OR (T1.PS = #{PS02} and T1.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T2.ACCT_NO)) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 /*付款方*/ON ((T1.PS = #{PS02} and T1.MY_ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO) OR (T1.PS = #{PS01} and T1.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO)) LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T5 ON T1.ORDER_ID = T5.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE T6 /*经办*/ON T5.SEQ_NO = T6.SEQ_NO AND T6.NODE_ID = #{TRADE_OPERATOR} LEFT JOIN SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE T7 /*复核*/ON T5.SEQ_NO = T7.SEQ_NO AND T7.NODE_ID = #{TRADE_CHECKER} WHERE T1.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE TT /*经办最大*/WHERE T5.SEQ_NO = TT.SEQ_NO AND TT.NODE_ID = #{TRADE_OPERATOR} AND TT.HIS_NO > T6.HIS_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE TT /*复核最大*/WHERE T5.SEQ_NO = TT.SEQ_NO AND TT.NODE_ID = #{TRADE_CHECKER} AND TT.HIS_NO > T7.HIS_NO)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH WHERE TRADE_ID IN (#{item.bizCode} )
mapper.update: update STL_DVP_ORDERS set ORDER_ID = #{bizCodeR},ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus02} where ORDER_ID = #{bizCode}
update STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH set ORDER_ID = #{bizCodeR} where ORDER_ID = #{bizCode}
